results.title: Power supply curtailed in parts of Kumasi as illegal logging damages GRIDCo line
results.content: Power supply to parts of the Western and Ashanti regions has been disrupted after illegal chainsaw operators felled a large tree onto a major 330kV transmission line operated by the Ghana Grid Company Limited (GRIDCo).

results.title: Poundland collapses putting 11,000 jobs at risk
results.content: Poundland has collapsed into administration, putting 11,000 jobs at risk, after its owners failed to find a buyer to keep it in business.

results.title: Shareholders back PBC’s GH¢300m debt restructuring plan
results.content: Shareholders of Produce Buying Company (PBC), Ghana’s largest licensed cocoa buying company, have approved a plan to raise GH¢300 million from the capital market to restructure the company’s finances and revive its cocoa purchasing operations.

results.title: Ghana’s legal framework for energy transition: Is the Renewable Energy Act, 2011 (ACT 832), fit for the country’s net-zero ambitions?
results.content: Ghana’s commitment to achieving net-zero emissions by 2060 presents significant opportunities and challenges for the country’s energy sector. However, the principal legislation governing renewable energy development, the Renewable Energy Act, 2011 (Act 832), was enacted more than a decade before the country adopted its current long-term energy transition ambitions. This raises an important question as to whether the existing statutory framework is sufficiently equipped to facilitate the transition towards a low-carbon economy.

results.title: Women lawyers have a big role in law reforms – Ayine
results.content: Dr Dominic Akuritinga Ayine, Attorney General and Minister of Justice, expressed confidence that including women lawyers in law reform processes in Ghana and across Africa would accelerate legal development and strengthen access to justice.

results.title: Gunshots heighten tension at Nyanyano over chieftaincy dispute
results.content: Residents of Gomoa Nyanyano in the Gomoa East District of the Central Region have been thrown into fear following reports of sporadic gunfire amid escalating tensions over a planned homecoming celebration by traditional authorities.

results.title: GIMPA, Jobberman equip students with skills to navigate the competitive job market
results.content: A university degree may open doors, but securing employment requires more than academic qualifications, students at the Ghana Institute of Management and Public Administration (GIMPA) have been told. The message was central to the GIMPA–Jobberman Job Fair 2026, a two-day career development and recruitment initiative organised by the GIMPA Career Services Unit, under the Office of the Dean of Students, in collaboration with Jobberman Ghana. The event brought together GIMPA students and recruitment professionals for practical career preparation, professional guidance and direct engagement with recruitment opportunities. The first day of the programme, held at the GIMPA Moot Court, focused on CV and résumé writing, job application strategies and the essential competencies employers look for when recruiting graduates.

results.title: At least 30 killed in massive fire as fuel truck crashes on Cairo highway
results.content: At least 30 people have been killed and 19 others injured in a large fire on a busy highway in Cairo after a fuel tanker crashed, Egypt's health ministry says.

results.title: A well is a question, not an answer
results.content: In Chegu, in the Mion District, no rig is turning yet, but talk of oil has already begun. GNPC and GNPC Explorco are intensifying preparations to drill the TUA-1X exploratory well. For a region that has long waited for national attention, hope is natural. But the key word is EXPLORATORY. WHAT THE WELL DOES An exploratory well tests an idea. Aerial surveys and years of underground studies suggest where oil or gas might lie, but only drilling can confirm it. Officials have been careful on this point: the Petroleum Commission has stressed that there has been no commercial discovery in the basin. The well may find nothing, find hydrocarbons too small or too hard to reach, or show promise that must then be tested by more wells.

results.title: Russia’s own figures show it has lost nearly 500,000 people in Ukraine war
results.content: At least 490,334 Russian soldiers have died since the start of the war in Ukraine in 2022, according to Russian government statistics analysed by the BBC.

results.title: Multimedia Group, GAPFA to offer fresh eggs, live chickens at farm-gate prices on December 4–5
results.content: The Multimedia Group Limited, in partnership with the Greater Accra Poultry Farmers Association (GAPFA), is set to roll out ‘Eggs and More Market’ to give the public access to fresh eggs, live chickens and other poultry products at farm-gate prices.

results.title: KAIPTC warns of rising online abuse targeting young people in Ghana
results.content: The Kofi Annan International Peacekeeping Training Centre (KAIPTC) has raised concerns about the vulnerability of young people in Ghana to cyberbullying, sexual blackmail and the non-consensual sharing of intimate images. The Centre says early education and prevention are critical to protecting students from technology-facilitated gender-based violence and helping victims access support. As part of efforts to address the threat, KAIPTC brought together 200 students from four senior high schools in Accra for a digital safety quiz and debate to launch its 2026 16 Days of Activism Against Gender-Based Violence campaign. The participating schools were Nungua Senior High School, Teshie Presby Senior High School, Labone Senior High School, and Ghana Armed Forces Senior High and Technical School.

results.title: COCOBOD awaits committee report on expired fertiliser complaints before action
results.content: the Ghana Cocoa Board (COCOBOD) says it will determine the next course of action over complaints of expired cocoa fertiliser in the Central Region after receiving a report from a committee investigating the matter.

results.title: MTN Ghana provides 20 desktop computers to Adako Jachie School to improve digital learning
results.content: MTN Ghana is enhancing digital learning in Adako Jachie in the Ashanti Region after donating a fully equipped ICT suite, comprising 20 desktop computers and essential accessories, to the Adako Jachie M/A Primary and Junior High School in the Ejisu Municipality.

results.title: Bank of Ghana pushes alternative data lending to widen loan access
results.content: The Bank of Ghana is pushing for the integration of alternative data into the country's credit system to help underserved individuals and small businesses access loans.

results.title: 13 remanded over alleged impersonation of NAIMOS operatives
results.content: Thirteen suspects arrested for allegedly impersonating operatives of the National Anti-Illegal Mining Operations Secretariat (NAIMOS) have been arraigned and remanded into custody. The suspects were arraigned on Tuesday, November 24, 2026, according to a statement issued by the Secretariat on Wednesday, November 25, and signed by its spokesperson, Paa Kwesi Schandorf. Six of the suspects were arrested in the Eastern Region, while the remaining seven were apprehended in the Western Region. NAIMOS said the suspects allegedly posed as its operatives to extort money from miners and engage in other unlawful activities.

results.title: Financial institutions urged to use alternative records, including Mobile Money, to boost financing for women farmers
results.content: Women farmers could secure bank loans using their mobile money transaction records instead of relying on physical assets as collateral, as the Ghana Venture Capital and Private Equity Association calls for a review of traditional lending practices to expand access to agricultural finance.

results.title: Maxbuy Goes Black with up to 60%

results.title: GNFS blames cooking for Timber Market fire, warns traders against domestic activities

results.title: Farmers report expired cocoa fertiliser complaints from various communities – Association president
